Five thousand years ago we faced floods like the Inazuma people😊 Four thousand years ago we played with bronze like the Mondstadt people🤗 Three thousand years ago we pondered philosophy like the Sumeru people🧐 Two thousand years ago we waged war everywhere like the Natlan people😠 One thousand years ago we were as rich as could be like the Fontaine people🥳 And now we go head to head with Snezhnaya😈 For five thousand years we have sat at the world's table😎 while our opponents have already changed several times😱 Come on Liyue people, spin it💪💪💪 For the Rex Lapis💃💃💃
Once upon a time there was a kingdom in the heavens with many flamboyant gods, and their boss was called "Shenxiao Leifu Chief Whatever Lightning-Chasing Demon Who Cleans the Toilet Every Day Divine Lord", named Jingyuan-yuan, short for Jingyuan. Jingyuan had seven daughters; the youngest was called the Balladeer, said to be the hottest and most beautiful flower, deeply favored by Jingyuan-yuan. The kingdom had a rule that you must not fall in love with mortals, so you could not go down to the human world. But the Balladeer was far too curious about the mortal world, so she sneaked away from Jingyuan-yuan and jumped off the Immortal-Executing Terrace. The first thing she did after descending was take a bath, but unexpectedly a trash can saw everything, so the Balladeer blushed shyly and would marry no one but the trash can. And so, after this destined encounter, the Balladeer and the trash can lived happily together - but this was soon known to Jingyuan-yuan in heaven. He was truly enraged, shouted a curse, flew over with a single kick, kicked the trash can far away, grabbed the Balladeer, and no matter how she cried and made a fuss Jingyuan-yuan would not budge. Unexpectedly the trash can did not give up; after a hundred years of bitter cultivation it finally mastered its divine skill on the seventh day of the seventh month, striding across the magpie bridge all the way, and charged up to the heavenly court. Locked in a desperate struggle with Jingyuan-yuan, the Balladeer shed tears, unable to bear watching the people she loved most destroy each other for her sake, so she swallowed a pill and flew to the moon, enduring thousands of years of loneliness alone.

Let's not talk about anything else, let's talk about Huawei's waterproofing. Last time my Huawei fell into the Mariana Trench, I thought the phone was definitely done for - either water would get in or the water pressure would burst it. What I never expected was that my Huawei used its Leica lens as eyes, automatically turned on the flashlight to light up the seafloor, used the phone's GPS as navigation, relied on the streamlined feel of the metal body, and kept paddling with the phone's vibration, and actually found me again! The warmth radiating from the Kirin 8-core CPU meant that when I got my Huawei back it wasn't cold to the touch, but slightly warm. At that moment, I truly felt the warmth of the motherland. I entered the great Huawei in this life, and in the next I'll still be Chinese. Next let's talk about Huawei's flash. Now I don't even wear a headlamp when I go mining - as soon as I take out my phone, the whole mine lights up. The signal is super strong. I remember one time our mine flooded and collapsed, over 6000 meters underground, and none of the 500+ coworkers' phones had signal. I took out my Huawei and made the emergency call. And Huawei's battery is awesome. When the rescue workers found us, the power had gone out due to the collapse, and they used ropes to pull up over 200 people. But suddenly a secondary collapse happened, and if we didn't rescue people quickly, it would all be over. I took the battery out of my Huawei and hooked up the elevator, and suddenly the whole mine had power. The elevator roared - before, it could only pull 10 people at a time, but with a Huawei battery it pulled over 50, and in 5 minutes everyone was rescued. After saving everyone, they gave me the battery back; after putting it back in it was still at 98%.

Enter the widget tutorial?
This tutorial will guide you step by step through this layout
(Strongly recommended for first-time users)
Tap the screen to enter the game; the functions at the bottom right are shown in the picture
Click the highlighted "📰" in the bottom right to view update notes and widget info, click "🖱️" to enter mouse control mode, click "?" to re-enter the tutorial
Swipe the blank screen area to move the camera
Drag the joystick to move around
Control the player at the bottom-right

'↑' is jump, '<<' is sprint, '🗡️' is left-click attack, '□' is right-click place, the Anemo burst 'F' swaps the off-hand item, and the inverted triangle '▼' at the bottom right is the Shift sneak lock
